name: Cornelius
summary: A centurion in Caesarea who feared God, gave generously and prayed always. An angel told him to send for Peter, and while Peter preached in his house, the Holy Ghost came upon the Gentiles who were listening.

key_moments.title: Visited by an Angel
key_moments.description: Cornelius, a devout centurion of the Italian band, saw an angel of God in a vision. The angel said his prayers and gifts had come up before God and told him to send men to Joppa for Simon Peter.

key_moments.title: Meeting Peter
key_moments.description: Cornelius gathered his relatives and close friends, and when Peter came in he fell at his feet to worship him. Peter lifted him up, saying that he too was only a man.

key_moments.title: Receives the Holy Ghost
key_moments.description: Cornelius told Peter about his vision, and Peter preached Jesus to everyone gathered there. While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Ghost came on all who heard, and they were baptized.
